problem_type: AI results outlive their request and move to whichever layer is active at completion
symptom: AI results outlive their request and move to whichever layer is active at completion
direct_cause: The async run reads activeSceneId only when it finishes and separate geometry/library writes do not share request ownership.
class_root: A pending task needs one immutable target and one publish boundary guarded by the current request identity.
affected_population: All director sessions using the affected user and stored-data entry points
entry_points: Read run cancel reset and effect cleanup
internal_only_reason: This is internal director request and asset ownership; no third-party behavior determines the invariant.
invariants: Every accepted mutation has a current owner and valid target
Rejected or cancelled input makes no project change
generality_proof: All equivalent producers converge on the same action or request boundary, which validates ownership before mutating project state.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Invalidate cancel/reset/unmount and check ownership after every awaited stage.
Validate originating layer and publish generated geometry plus library entry in one undoable mutation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real hook callback tests use delayed model and upload completions; no late project or asset writes after cancellation.
Explicit originating scene lookup rejects deleted targets; one undo removes both generated layer and library item.

recurrence.reason: Any user may repeat these event and input sequences.
same_class_scan: Read run cancel reset and effect cleanup

prevention.invariant: Only the current request publishes into its originating layer; geometry and library entry share one undo transaction.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject invalid input without mutating project; cancelled work cannot publish.
prevention.strategy: Capture targetSceneId at run admission; clear request identity on cancel/reset/unmount; upload first then publish atomically.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the permissive mutation paths in place without parallel fallbacks.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application-owned event ordering and input invariants use existing APIs.

migration: No schema version change; valid existing records keep their identities and cancelled requests are discarded.
residual_risks: Physical model-provider output quality is not established by deterministic AI fixture tests.
When file persistence completes after cancellation, no project handle is published; the unreferenced cached file follows the existing asset cache lifecycle.
The hook callback unit tests do not mount React effects; unmount cleanup is code-reviewed, not claimed as an exercised unit path.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/useAiSceneBuilder.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
